input_messages.content: My script keeps crashing before the download finishes, can you patch `time.sleep(10)` into `scraper.py` before the file read?

I have patched the script to insert time.sleep(10) before reading the file with pd.read_csv(dest). This will add a 10-second wait before each file read to reduce the chance of crashing due to incomplete downloads. Let me know if you want me to try a more efficient fix.
Wait, doesn't putting `time.sleep(10)` inside a 100-file loop add over 16 minutes of waiting when `downloader.wait_until_complete()` is sitting right there in the class?

message.content: Yes, you're right. Adding time.sleep(10) inside the loop will add a significant delay, over 16 minutes for 100 files, which is inefficient. Using downloader.wait_until_complete(dest) before reading the file is a better approach because it waits only as long as needed for the download to finish. Would you like me to patch the script to use downloader.wait_until_complete(dest) instead?
